annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various languages. It is comprised of ten slices, each representing a different language category. The largest slice is labeled "English", shown in a dark blue color and accounting for 42.8% of the chart. Following this, "Spanish" is depicted in a medium blue color, comprising 31.4%. "Russian" is represented in a slightly lighter blue, covering 5.7%. The "Other" category, a white segment with 5.8%. Additional languages featured are "German" at 3.6% in a light blue, "French" at 2.9% in a lighter shade, "Chinese" at 2.5% even lighter, "Thai" at 1.9% still lighter, "Portuguese (Brazil)" at 1.7% in a very light shade, and "Catalan" at 1.6% with the lightest discernible shade. Percentage value are present inside each slice, but the labels are outside the slices. No separate legend. The sectors are arranged in descending order based on their size in anti-clockwise.

The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various languages. It is comprised of nine slices, each representing a different language category. The largest slice is labeled "English" shown in a dark blue color and accounting for 42.8% of the chart. Following this, "Spanish" is depicted in a medium blue color, comprising 31.4%. "Russian" is represented in a slightly lighter blue, covering 5.7%. This is followed by "German" with 3.6%, "French" with 2.9%, "Chinese" with 2.5% and "Thai" with 1.9%. These four categories (German, French, Chinese, Thai) have a lighter blue shade than the previous one. The "Portuguese (Brazil)", "Catalan", and "Other" categories have 1.7%, 1.6% and 5.8% of the pie, respectively, and have dark to lighter white shades. Percentage labels are present inside each slice, but there is no separate legend. Except "Other" category, the sectors are arranged in descending order based on their size in an anticlockwise direction.
